Wind Signal

TCWS No. 3
Luzon
The northern portion of mainland Cagayan (Santa Ana, Gonzaga, Aparri, and Buguey) and Babuyan Islands
Wind threat: Storm-force winds
Warning lead time: 18 hours
Range of wind speeds: 89 to 117 km/h (Beaufort 10 to 11)
Potential impacts: Moderate to significant

TCWS No. 2
Luzon
Batanes, the rest of Cagayan, the northern and central portions of Isabela (Palanan, Divilacan, Maconacon, San Pablo, and Ilagan City), Apayao, and Ilocos Norte
Wind threat: Gale-force winds
Warning lead time: 24 hours
Range of wind speeds: 62 to 88 km/h (Beaufort 8 to 9)
Potential impacts: Minor to moderate

TCWS No. 1
Luzon
The rest of Isabela, the northern portion of Aurora (Dilasag, Casiguran, and Dinalungan), Kalinga, Abra, Metro Manila, and Polillo Islands
Visayas
Northern Samar and Eastern Samar
Mindanao
Dinagat Islands and Siargao Islands
Wind threat: Strong winds
Warning lead time: 36 hours
Range of wind speeds: 39 to 61 km/h (Beaufort 6 to 7)
Potential impacts: Minimal to minor
